newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake unit faces bankruptcy filing.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake unit faces bankruptcy filing.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp said on Monday an involuntary petition for reorganisation under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Federal Bankruptcy Code was filed against its operating unit Reddi Brake Supply Co Inc.

The involuntary petition was filed by a group of four unsecured creditors of the subsidiary in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California in Santa Barbara, Calif., the company said.
The company was not immediately available to comment further.
